description: Inspect dtypes, shapes, ONNX domains and external-data references before choosing a runtime. Download a structural compatibility checklist. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Reports facts and unresolved runtime requirements; it does not certify inference support for a particular framework version. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: model_compat
title: Check model structure
